notes.title: Momento 🧸 Get Exclusive Beta Access!
notes.notes:
[p]Hello everyone![/p][p]Jasmine here, taking over for Jess while she’s on her maternity leave. 🌻 We hope you’ve been well! ✨ It’s officially September now, which means we’re in -ber month territory! (Can you hear the holiday songs playing in the air already?) 🎁 This update will be a short one but we’ve got exciting news for those waiting to play a build of Momento! 🤩[/p][p][/p][h3]What’s Been Happening?[/h3][p]Our closed playtesting sessions are in full swing! 🎮 It’s so incredible to watch everyone experience for the first time what Momento has to offer. Thank you so much to those who have received their own Steam keys and have spent time playtesting the game. Your feedback has been invaluable in shaping the game these last few weeks! 🙏[/p][p]In other exciting news, our team is growing once more - 🎉 welcome Will to the team everyone! 🎉 Will is joining us as part of the narrative team to help while Jess is away on maternity leave. They have worked on some pretty incredible projects (such as Date Everything!) and their voice has been a lovely addition to Momento. We’re pretty stoked to have them on board![/p][p]Speaking of growing families, Jess and Julian have welcomed their little one into the world! 👶 Everyone is safe, and both baby Evelyn and Jess are recovering and adjusting well. Thank you to everyone’s well wishes![/p][p]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44776801/e50857e3fcff48a8b4c477fbe6279a7a7b1691aa.png"][/img][i]Our weekly theme in our Discord (private for now but not for long!) is Messiest Room! (📷 by bloo)[/i][/p][p][/p][h3]What’s Next?[/h3][p]Okay friends, this is not a drill 🚨 We are fast approaching our exclusive beta testing with our entire mailing list group! 🚨[/p][p]The only way to receive a unique Steam Key is to be part of the mailing list, so if you haven't signed up to our mailing list yet, please do so [url="https://subscribe.playmomento.com/"]here[/url]! If you have any other friends or family who you think would be interested, please let them know, too - we’d love to have them! 🎉[/p][p]There’s not a lot of specifics to touch on at the moment, but I can tell you that production is going full steam ahead! 🚂 The entire team is heads down and hard at work making this game into something we’re hopeful will be worth the wait 💖 We can’t thank you all enough for all your patience and encouragement![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44776801/0cbbc920b02485734c8a719141445da79443d4db.jpg"][/img][i]Our team send-off (except for our music team - we missed you!) before Jess and Julian’s parental leave 🥂[/i][/p][p][/p][p]That’s it from me 😊 I hope you all have a lovely September, and we’ll see you all in our Discord for our exclusive Beta session soon! 🫶[/p][p][/p][p]Jasmine and the Momento Team[/p][p][/p]

notes.title: Momento 🧸 Beta Testing Starting Soon!
notes.notes:
[p]Hello![/p][p][/p][p]Hope you are doing well! I can’t believe that it is almost July! The year just flies by when you’re developing a game. I swear I did start writing this newsletter in May but there’s been a lot going on. 🤯 If you’ve been seeing us more on social media - we’ve hired a community manager to pick up on our slack![/p][p][/p][p]First things first: we’re in the Cozy and Family Friendly Festival on Steam at the moment as a Featured Upcoming Game! ✨ If you haven’t already checked it out, you should do so - there’s a lot of very cool games featured and some of our friends have demos up (if you like cute cats and delivering mail, check out [u][url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/2908050/Cattos_Post_Office/"]Catto’s Post Office[/url][/u])![/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44776801/c6d3dfa4cb024a87cf0ac0add386362e2ded2135.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]We’re so grateful to our friends at RokaPlay for organising this event and allowing us to be part of it. Don’t forget to sign up to their [u][url="https://cozygamescelebration.beehiiv.com/subscribe"]Cozy and Family Friendly Newsletter[/url][/u] to keep up to date with all things cozy games! 🌷[/p][p][/p][p]👀 Meanwhile, in game development:[/p][p][/p][p]😎 Julian is currently doing some work on user experience and feedback in the placement system allowing for more precision placement of items. He’s recently added in the VFX and UI for affinity selection, dynamic state changes, and a placement tool which allows for some really neat stuff (yes, we can finally stack the blocks in a pyramid! 😭🙏)[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44776801/bda77960c7a8ea4bd49f8635b62d67bf08e86048.gif"][/img][/p][p][i]Which will you choose: dino, teddy, or unicorn?[/i][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44776801/690ab43422226df0573756a6c239669984e9aada.png"][/img][/p][p][i]Not just a flat pyramid either… a full on 3D pyramid. 📐 Yes, we use 2D assets.[/i][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44776801/3a53d8e1e750e5636df0b3cab4acf409bcf059d2.gif"][/img][/p][p][i]Dynamic state changes! The object automatically changes based on where you are hovering so you can decorate those side walls with eaaaase.[/i][/p][p][/p][p]✍️🎨 Jasmine and I have been trying to tie up content for the beta. We’ve had to do a giant overhaul of our furniture and item database to fast track our content creation pipeline, so Jasmine has had to create a lot of template items to unblock whiteboxing.[/p][p][/p][p]Speaking of whiteboxing, we did a big whitebox review where we played through the whole game to see if the story direction works in the way we want it to - which I’m glad to say that it does in general! There’s a lot of things that need fleshing out and some shifting around but we can see the vision. 📚[/p][p][/p][p]💾 Zac (our systems programming wizard!) has been working on optimization for the game ahead of the beta- we have [i]so many[/i] assets in terms of furniture and items that we have to make sure we have a way to load them all in without slowing down the game.[/p][p][/p][p]🖥️ Ryan has joined the team full time to help with UI and biz dev work! He has been working on the Creative Mode UI, which we also plan to have available in the beta. He’s recently added a search bar so you search things by type, which we’re hoping to expand so we can search multiple tags. [/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44776801/a36ae876c8574612be3072a0c34f0fc39f384ad6.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]🎧 Our sound designers and composers are working on new sounds and music. Story mode has a bunch of new interactions and UI which need some chill sound effects to give feedback as you make choices and uncover the story.[/p][p][/p][p]💡 We have a shader artist contracted (the wonderful Crystal) to look into more dynamic lighting, but this won’t be available for a little while yet! In the meantime she has been cleaning up and optimising all the shaders in the game![/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44776801/6ad525b5642f44968743321ce9b3a0676b791f13.png"][/img][/p][p][i]I’ve been using the precision placement tools to make very cluttered bookcases.[/i][/p][p]
❗ On to [b][i]beta news[/i][/b]! Thank you so much for your patience. Our beta is going to be available to play to closed groups in the next few months! We still have some setup to do for this, as we will start testing in small groups before making it fully open to the whole mailing list. We will also have a Discord for the game opening up at the same time - so you can keep up to date with all the changes we will be making to the demo as you play it. ❗[/p][p][/p][p]We are so, so very close to having something for you all to play. 🙏 Keep an ear out! 🥰[/p][p][/p][p]Hope your weekends have been amazing![/p][p]Jess and the Momento team[/p]

notes.title: Momento’s 🧸 New Room Sizes
notes.notes:
Hello Hello!

We’ve been working on the new rooms that we chatted about in the last post, getting them laid out and getting all the new affinity objects in! 🤩 They look super pretty, Jasmine has done a really nice job with the art for the objects:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44776801/201a5a05155b6838bbae0e9c2fe671a1673ca809.png[/img]
[i](I really just love playing around in creative mode every day to test stuff out)[/i]

We’ve also been working on creating different room sizes in the engine as we have been whiteboxing out all the levels so we now have the creative freedom to have small rooms, long rooms, tall rooms, large rooms, and deep rooms! 🤯 In addition, we also have room component blocks so we can make some cool overhangs and dividing walls.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44776801/e555935b560d033d86f2f3fb253c72605f9db05a.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44776801/eee3ed1adf1a4de5dd3074005814ecb43bb8e533.png[/img]
[i](All of these are in engine! Apart from my rough drawovers haha)[/i]

We have our activity meter and task system set up as well! The more you decorate and explore the room, the more the activity meter will go up - you may even find some hidden puzzles and achievements which will give you bonus points. There are two extra special objects you can unlock on the activity meter.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44776801/d22b03c32bf5f7983e0bc3c5fca3b340efe9c89c.png[/img]
[i](New UI in game!)[/i]

Zac has implemented our story tree so we can hook up rooms based on the outcome of previous rooms, so we’ll be able to play through our story and ensure that all the decisions are working and that the branches are making sense.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44776801/42643139b1883508fb68349b38b33f80857f0e84.png[/img]
[i](The start of our story editor tree)[/i]

We also have a tech artist looking over our shaders at the moment and working out all those issues that we couldn’t quite solve (I do not have a math brain). So as well as being super readable, we have our occlusion masks working again and can hide things in bowls all whilst using a shader! 🥣

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44776801/9c23bab42f11cd815c0d6a420d1cdd355a914475.gif[/img]
[i](If it fits, I sits)[/i]

[b]What’s happening next??[/b]

Well, we’re going to continue polishing these new rooms for our demo. Jasmine is back from her holidays in Japan (Julian and I were very jealous) and is making the finalized furniture art for the remaining demo rooms! I’m helping out with a few of the more tedious tasks and then I’ll be jumping back into a second pass of whiteboxing (adding temp items to the new rooms).

Julian, on the other hand, will be some super secret squirrel stuff that we’ll be very excited to show you soon!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44776801/14e0f791df578884e16f7277708d8198d9fdd07a.png[/img]
[i](It would be super cool to add little challenges to creative mode like ‘decorate a tiny space’ - what kind of challenges would you like?)[/i]

Hope you have a great week ahead of you! 🥰
Jess and the Momento Team

notes.title: Momento’s 🧸 New Affinity System
notes.notes:
Hope your holiday period was joyous and relatively stress free! 🥳 We also briefly holidayed and have been back in action since early January - we haven’t disappeared off the face of the Earth, we promise! 🌏 After doing an internal playtest, we’ve been prototyping some new game systems that have changed a few things about gameplay for the better. We’re hoping to get a play tester demo into your hands ASAP - we haven’t forgotten! 🙏

A lot of cool stuff has been happening in the past two months, some of which we can’t talk about just yet, but what has been happening on the game that we can talk about? WELL:

🖥️ In programming/design, we all came up with some new gameplay systems as we felt there were some things lacking in our previous build. We now have a cool new feature called an affinity system, which are choices between objects that you choose in the room which spawn more objects based off of that. These affinity choices also affect the path you traverse in the game - so choose wisely. 🤔

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44776801/16df1c6214f1311e8e38244ae6eea7fb9c1fa06d.gif[/img]
[i]Here’s a concept gif of the affinity choice that Jasmine has mocked up.[/i]

Also in programming and design, Julian has been improving the placement system to allow for greater precision in placement (using some linear algebra and vector mathematics) and already things are placing way nicer than they used to be! Zac is repurposing our story-mode editor to handle our new systems and allow me to create our story rooms by playing the game! 🙌🤯

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44776801/bf3b4a5078e3d95889209263c585f30eb254ff1c.png[/img]
[i]Julian’s crazy gizmos for calculating placements (don't worry they are only for dev debugging and won't be in the final game).[/i]

🎨 On the art side… Jasmine is concepting up the new affinity item selections (as they will contain both the key choice and minor items that will swap out based on your choice). Our affinities are 🧪 Academic/Science, 🖌️ Creative/Art, and ⚽ Sport/Adventure (all with their own little quirks and additions) so we are trying to make items that match these! She’s also started conceptualizing the final versions of all our rooms based on our whiteboxed layouts - so yes, the childhood bedroom you’ve seen so much of is likely to have some changes! 👀

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44776801/8e2d789e22a46b324da7e3aef2307bae41146c73.png[/img]
[i]Version A, B, C of one of our new childhood bedrooms[/i]

📖 Which brings us to the story side of things! We did a massive rescope of the story tree at the end of January, trimming a lot of things that weren’t necessary ✂️ and picking the strongest story paths to move forward with 💪 (thankfully, we’d written a lot of different ones previously so we really like where we ended up!). These story trees are a little boring to look at (plus, don’t want to spoil anything!), so I’ll just share some of the vibes of some of the rooms instead. ✨

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44776801/c7524f6e1c3a5fd7f3cd9a485d6468d0e14ecc1f.png[/img]
[i]References we’ve pulled off google to inform how to further conceptualise our chosen rooms.[/i]

Thank you so much for your continued patience and support! ♥️ Game development is an absolute web of several things going on at once. We have a lot of major beats coming up and we hope to keep you up-to-date with everything that’s going on! Everything is cranking up a notch this year and we’re very excited to share a slice of Momento with you soon.

Hope you have a great week ahead of you! 🥰
Jess and the Momento Team

notes.title: Momento’s 🧸 End of Year Wrap Up 🎁🎄
notes.notes:
Happy Holidays!! Hope you are doing well! Thank you everyone who signed up to our playtesting form 🥰 we had a lot of interest so we will be going through them to start picking people for our first round of playtesting in January ♥️ Be sure to sign up to our newsletter to be notified about future playtesting rounds!

We’ve been doing a lot this past month and a bit! We had a push to get a playable version of the story mode for a local showcase night earlier in the month and we’ve been rebuilding rooms to allow for different sized rooms (getting tiling wall/floor assets etc.) Zac has also made us a hue-shift tool somewhat working so we and you will be able to change the colours of some of our items! Some of these include shelves, ottomans, beds, and paint tubes! Jasmine has been making the appropriate colour palettes for them 🤩🎨

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44776801/09fc160f798c1477a24f4bfddb27c25e031b3fff.gif[/img]
[i](I did not intend for this to loop so beautifully… but it did)[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44776801/fa0a8ee5b08754fbd9c0fc5b968abbdcc06ccba3.png[/img]
[i]Jasmine has also been testing out furniture that you could pop together and change around: kind of like modular IKEA prefabs.[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44776801/8afc4db596555daa20e8f0f6cc5283b64c38296a.png[/img]
[i]Jasmine has also been doing some basic concepts of our level select, we expect this will change and evolve next year.[/i]

Julian has worked out some interval puzzle stuff as well as changing room sizes so we can have BIGGER and smaller and narrower and wider rooms. He’s currently working on system for some letters you can collect throughout the game.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44776801/924e100ef43255c449d3696f53e48328d03b95cf.png[/img]

I’ve been building the story branches in the engine, here’s a little sneak peak! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44776801/181ff956bef9b78d6452ba65d6337efae8654f00.png[/img]
[i](Some of the art is still grey as they are temporary objects 😅)[/i]

[table noborder=1 equalcells=1]
    [tr]
        [td][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44776801/a2da6d6f5e5a37dad0c570adf1ea0aa815904c9a.png[/img][/td]
        [td][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44776801/d66fcb53659b41b5d41e0df90b89fe781cd4ca67.gif[/img][/td]
    [/tr]
[/table]

There's still a lot we’re going to add to this prototype before we show the early playtesters! We’ll be going through a lot of the rooms we already have and looking for what we are missing. I wish I could also show you what our sound design team have been doing because it sounds BEAUTIFUL but alas, you’ll have to wait!

It’s amazing to look back and see how much we have achieved in this year! We built creative mode to build story mode, as well as the story mode builder. We did a lot of development on the narrative design for Momento, as well as all the art tests and standardization. We have a huge database for furniture and items, as well as our hue-shift tool to change their colours! We also went to a few showcases both local and international! 🤯 I know it’s been a quieter year for us on socials but we’ve been making a lot of good work! There are a couple more tests we need to do by the end of the year but soon we’ll just be building the story, making tons of art, and getting it out to our playtesters! 

Thank you so much for following our journey so far! We wish you a very happy holiday season and new year! You’ll be hearing from us in January 🎆

Lots of love
Jess and the Momento Team

notes.title: Momento 🧸 100k Wishlists and Pet Overload
notes.notes:
How are you? It feels like it has been (checks calendar) forever! Julian and I have been away doing showcases and talks and pitches and conferences but we’re back now and everyone is (mostly) healthy. We’ve reached 100,000 wishlists on Momento! We can’t believe we’d ever get to such a number when we first started this game! Thank you to everyone who has wishlisted and everyone who has joined us on our mailing list since then 🥰 we couldn’t be doing this without you!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44776801/d2fe016f3a80da1c6d2c00704e7959f4f1e974ae.png[/img]

Now back to the fun stuff: whilst Julian and I flew around the country with our 18 month old (conferencing with a toddler: not recommended), Jasmine and our programmer have been doing some super cool stuff in the engine like…drum roll🥁

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44776801/19c6f8b634aac0b46a572f0631e0fad0b90fb8ee.gif[/img]

OBJECT STATES: you can now rotate books to be different perspectives and open them 💕 (these are temp objects which is why they are currently greyscale). I am FROTHING🤤.

We’re planning to add this ability to some of our furniture as well - you can already open cupboards and drawers but you’ll also be able to turn chairs around to place them under desks and so on. 🛋️

We’re doing a HUGE content push for story mode at the moment. 💪 Which means Jasmine and I are doing a lot of temp art to import into the game whilst Julian and Zac work on the systems required such as the choice system, character relationship manager, clutter system, task system, and journal system to name a few. Now that we have our creative mode and a lot of awesome tools that our programming team has made, it is so much easier for us to add new objects and make more rooms super fast! 🏃

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44776801/e08636b2cc1737e81850cd037fbe0e676a0affa4.png[/img]
[i]We've been testing out different room sizes - here's some sketches Jasmine has done on our massive Miro board for story mode.[/i]

In our latest newsletter, we asked you to tell us what kind of pets you would like to see in Momento (pictures were highly recommended!). We read through all of your replies and now have an overload of cute pet inspiration. Thank you all for sharing part of your lives with us 💕 If you haven't already, be sure to sign up to our newsletter if you'd like to have a say and help us with Momento's development!

That’s all for now - we have a few deadlines to meet before the end of the year so it’s back to the grindstone for us!

Hope you have a wonderful week ahead of you 🥰

Jess and the Momento Team

notes.title: Momento 🧸 is in Story Mode 📖
notes.notes:
First up is a recap from Gamescom! Over the 5 days, Jasmine met and chatted with so many wonderful people who had an incredible time playing Momento’s Creative Mode! She received valuable feedback which we’ll be working hard to implement into our next build. We hope you enjoy the stickers and postcards Jasmine gave away, as well as the TimTams (which was a crowd favorite!) Thank you again for stopping by and playing! 👋🥰

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44776801/dbc559b33668ea99583e1b1f7da875f679634d01.png[/img]
[i]Jasmine at Gamescom - the cat is a big hit.[/i]

We are currently working on ✨Story Mode✨!! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44776801/7c1f9311e16dcdb8182a73bd0c8804b45ea2c531.gif[/img]

Now that she’s recovered from Gamescom, Jasmine is doing a review of our art system along with our programmer Zac who is creating an item importer tool so we can get to putting together those story rooms in the engine ASAP. Soon she’ll be doing art for more rooms and more objects. We’re also going to do a redesign of the journal and how that’ll function. 🎨

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44776801/606affafd45f6c5a1cf6b2e0b7a80eee3c31be85.gif[/img]
[i]Testing out our clutter scatter system.[/i]

Julian is setting up all our systems for our story mode which is so exciting to see. We’ve got a clutter system started and are working on a ‘moment in time’ system which will spawn new story items and clutter items. He’s also working on a relationship system at the moment, which’ll affect the characters in the playable character’s life. 🎁

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44776801/d94a9b0b126c1f53681f4b5c850e98112a1a5a62.jpg[/img]
[i]Journal Layout Concept[/i]

I’m writing some story stuff (all those story paths and aforementioned characters) and making some cool shaders at the moment - including a hue-shift one so we can change the colour of some of the furniture and walls and floors without making 10000 different assets of the same thing. We’re also starting to sketch up all the different story paths, so we can’t wait to show you more room assets soon!  ✍️

That’s all from us for now~ We hope you are all doing well! 🥰

Can’t wait to hear back from you all 🫰
Jess and the Momento Team

notes.title: Momento 🧸 is heading to Gamescom!
notes.notes:
Hope you are doing well! 😊In the last month we have: shown off our creative mode at the [url=https://www.queenslandgamesfestival.com/]Queensland Games Festival[/url], applied for some showcases, and Jasmine got a grant to jet off to Gamescom in Cologne next month! Let me show you what's been going on!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44776801/1f0fa8f36591e2bf9b794e696345f070c0af0f41.jpg[/img]
[i]Our latest creative mode build! 🌜Night Time Version🌛[/i]

Our creative mode build is what Jasmine and I will be using to build all the different rooms and connect them with the story-lines that have been laid out! It’ll also be available as a mode you can play in Momento where more items and furniture will unlock as you play through the story (plus maybe there’ll be some hidden ways to get more stuff? 👀)

This is some of the features it has so far:

[list]
[*] Place furniture: Comfort (seating, beds); Surfaces (desks, shelves, bookcases etc.); Wall Items (corkboards, mirrors); Floor Items (rugs etc.), Appliances, Storage.
[*] Place windows! We have backgrounds (currently one (1) but there’ll be more) drawn so when you move the windows around you can find the view you want! There’ll be season changes 🤭 we love making more work for ourselves.
[*] Place objects from a wide ranging list from cushions to plants to laboratory equipment!
[*] This build has five wallpapers and floors to choose from but there’s going to be way, way more.
[*] Can also choose the colour of the wall trim!
[*] Change the time of day from Morning, Midday, and Night time. (Night-time is my favourite. Especially when you add all the glow in the dark stars everywhere 😍 More.)
[*] Take a photo and save your beautiful (or cursed) creations~
[/list]

Here’s what we are working on this month.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44776801/8946abc14cd019c3754d7ee3710dfb89a0f83a20.gif[/img]

Julian: 
[list]
[*] Adjusting the placement system! No more things just hovering in midair :’) though you’ll be able to toggle that on and off in the options if you REALLY want to have things hover in midair. 
[*] Object layering system adjustments.
[*] Julian is also working on a light layering system because at the moment lights that are behind other objects are still rendering in front of those objects.
[*] Branching system rework.
[*] Journal system.
[*] Bin system
[*] Clutter object system.
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44776801/b91030cefdd0183fef59bc4d62700b3631cc9482.png[/img]
[i]Colour passes for bug catcher and foster cat interval puzzles.[/i]

Jasmine:
[list]
[*] Art for the rooms and interval puzzles for our vertical slice build to show at upcoming festivals!
[*] Art for the journal UI (including a character creator of a sort? 👀)
[*] Asset layering adjustments.
[*] Reviewing existing assets to ensure furniture with cupboards have an open state.
[*] Mask textures for lighting setups on objects.
[*] Getting ready for gamescom!
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44776801/608ef9e118ee9331746ba3a86552452bbda6ed4a.png[/img]

Jess:
[list]
[*] Vertical slice twine update - making sure it makes sense to play through.
[*] Spreadsheets, so many spreadsheets. Spreadsheets for object descriptions, spreadsheets for task list tasks, spreadsheets for journal entries, spreadsheets of consequences.
[*] Reworking story treatment document.
[*] Shaders and headaches for lighting set-ups (currently working on those window gobos I mentioned.)
[*] Shaders for key objects and locations.
[*] Mask textures for lighting set-ups.
[*] Story object art.
[*] This news post 🥰
[/list]

Anyhow, we’d best get back to work! We have a lot to get done over the next month and a half! This month’s question is: What kind of room would you like to make in the Creative Mode? I hope you have a fabulous July ahead! For those in the Northern Hempisphere, enjoy your summer months! It is freezing down here! 🥶

All the love,
Jess and the Momento Team 💕

notes.title: Momento🧸 went to GDC! 💃
notes.notes:
Current Goal: Experiment and playtest choice mechanic and narrative mechanics.

I’m back from the Game Developers Conference in San Francisco! It was a wild time. I met so many super cool people, listened to a lot of informative talks, showcased the Momento demo at the Australian GDC Reception, and lost my passport 😱 (don’t worry I found it again!). 😮‍💨

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44776801/6e10500950380beb5b4641566a20029e388836bd.png[/img]
Here’s Momento and I at the bar, just grabbing a drink together at the Australian GDC Reception y’know. 🍻

We also got Screen Australia funding recently as announced [url=https://www.screenaustralia.gov.au/sa/media-centre/news/2024/03-21-over-one-million-for-games-industry]here[/url]! 🎉👯
So now that I’m back, we’re doing a huge overhaul to our build, implementing new systems and experimenting with some new mechanics. ⚙️ We have a few design choices to figure out and a whole overarching narrative to implement, and a lot of assets to make. You know when you want to share your ideas but you don’t want to give anything away?? That’s my current conundrum right now, writing to you. 👀 Thus, unfortunately we don’t have a lot of new things to show you right now but I can share some art from the past couple of months! 🖼️

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44776801/b4ecd0fe1551a848731dd1c642aeba1c04cbfda9.png[/img]

[*]Concepting new gameplay mechanics.
[/list]
Julian
[list]

notes.title: Momento celebrates International Women's Day!
notes.notes:
[b]Current Goal:[/b] Showcase Momento at GDC and keep polishing our current build

Hey everyone! How are you all doing? March is going to be very busy for us, but first things first:

Happy Birthday, Momento! 🎉🎉🎉

It’s been almost a year since we first came up with the idea of Momento and we’ve come so far in a year. Thank you for your continued support and interest in our cozy little game! (Also it’s Issy’s birthday in less than a week too! Happy birthday, Issy - I don’t know how you’re already one year old but it feels like it’s been an entire lifetime!)

Momento will also be part of the [url=https://twitter.com/womenledgames/status/1762489792304959668]Women Led Games Showcase[/url] on March 8-10! Celebrate International Women’s Day with us by watching the live show on [url=https://www.twitch.tv/womenledgames]Twitch[/url] or [url=https://www.youtube.com/@women-ledgames]Youtube[/url] on March 8th 5PM EST!

I (Jess) was selected to be part of the Future Leaders’ Delegation organised by the games section of the Australian Government - so I will be headed over to San Francisco to showcase Momento at some events during the Game Developers’ Conference. Jasmine and Julian will be manning the fort!

[b]Back to the game’s progress! What’s been going on?[/b]
[list]
[*] Testing how best to structure our naming conventions so we don’t have to redo it a million times
[*] Freshening up our pitch deck for GDC
[*] Lining up meetings, and meetings, and [i]more meetings…[/i]
[*] Polishing the latest prototype build
[*] Fleshing out the narrative branches and story item descriptions
[*] Exploring gameplay mechanics for choosing key objects
[/list]

[/list]

[/list]
Thank you so much for your support and interest in Momento! We can’t wait to show you more soon!

Cheers,
Jess and the Momento Team 💖

notes.title: Breaking for the Holidays!
notes.notes:
[i]Note: Julian, Jess and Jasmine are all parents so we are each splitting our time between caring commitments and working on the game. This means we only have 2-3 days each week to work on Momento, we are dedicated to making the best game possible but this limitation will mean production may take longer than usual. [/i]

[h2]Current Goal: Take a nap 😴[/h2]

Happy holidays, everyone! It’s the festive season 🎉 and the Momento team is taking a break over the Christmas - New Year period! Although how much of a break does one really get with young children? As I write this Julian is lying on the floor distracting Issy with toys. 🙃 However we did get an awesome sleep-in until 8am this morning whilst extended family looked after her.

A lot has been happening over the last month and a bit! We released our Steam Page alongside our trailer in the Wholesome Snack on December 6 and now have over 18,000 wishlists! 🤯 I think it’s time we had a look back on our year in review:
[list]
[*][b]February[/b]: The Momento team was formed and we started brainstorming some game ideas. I think there was a second-hand shop repurposing idea in there somewhere, and some sort of zoo tycoon inspired game. But Momento was the one that really struck a chord. 
[*][b]March[/b]: 👶 Issy made her entrance into the world. Jess went on maternity leave whilst recovering from major surgery. Momento was chosen as the idea to take forward.
[*][b]April[/b]: Jasmine and Julian began experimentation whilst continuing to work contract work for four days a week. 💪 [i](Jess in the trenches)[/i]
[*][b]May[/b]: We pitched Momento on TikTok and it went viral! [i](If anyone tells you maternity leave is a holiday… deck them)[/i]
[*][b]June[/b]: Julian and Jasmine finished their contract work and the Momento website was built. [i](From my vague and distorted memories… taking care of Issy got slightly easier at this point)[/i]
[*][b]July[/b]: Jess returned to work! 🥹 Julian and Jess now worked two days a week each whilst splitting care for Isabelle. Momento website went live.
[*][b]August[/b]: We put together a submission for Screen Queensland grant funding. We created more rooms for the game, and we got covered by [url=https://www.gamesradar.com/this-cozy-room-decorating-game-is-going-to-be-the-next-unpacking/]Gamesradar[/url]!
[*][b]September[/b]: Started on prototype production and started mapping out individual story-paths. whilst preparing to head off to GCAP in early October.
[*][b]October[/b]: Julian and Jasmine headed to GCAP where they pitched to some publishers. We applied for more grants, continued prototyping, put together our Steam Page, and made a game trailer for the Wholesome Snack.
[*][b]November[/b]: Julian worked every available Momento 😁 to get a prototype ready in time for our end of year showcase with Screen Queensland. Meanwhile Jess and Jasmine worked on finalising the Steam Page, even more grant funding applications (the applications never end…), and getting everything ready for the Wholesome Snack.
[*][b]December[/b]: Ramped up for the Wholesome Snack and Steam Page reveal! ✨ Then we did some end of year stuff, celebrated receiving the Screen Queensland grant, and participated in the showcase at the Screen Queensland residency. Currently we are enjoying a little breather before we knuckle down to work in the new year. 🫡
[/list]
[img]https://ci3.googleusercontent.com/meips/ADKq_NbvyJqo7gBkKqmPT6xwUwFAdSZ_7K4HUAaLXRsjpnzKXmk9Pp2s4i19Al52VPe-QSZ1qryMeCJGzh1IPrGvdE_mfqMEqhGdCFsF9MUFU2Wuy9xW3e-8pufIKyP-x2npBJCPrf8OYubuUOs1jfCn97hg=s0-d-e1-ft#https://storage.mlcdn.com/account_image/565654/cOHOyzCAFMzD8tjlViaukZ50JD2YA76ihiDY98Sw.png[/img]
Happy Holidays! 🎀
Lots of Love 💕 
Jess and the Momento Team
